purpose: Offline evaluation of simulated wrench readings at the samples delivered to the unmodified controller. All forces are normal to the tray, in newtons.
condition: Kalman + LQR circle, seed 401, 0.1 ms joint-acceleration filter time constant, 0.2 N normal-force gate.

fields.measurement_time_s: Simulated raw sample timestamp including startup hold. The shape starts at t=0.550 s.
fields.delivery_time_s: Time the tested controller received the selected sample, after the sensor delay.
fields.feedback_fz_n: Reconstructed from the torque proxy using noisy joint-velocity differentiation. This is the value the controller receives.
fields.contact_fz_n: MuJoCo ball–tray contact force projected onto the tray normal; evaluator only.
fields.exact_acceleration_shadow_fz_n: The unloaded observer at the same posture, using exact simulated joint accelerations, without added joint torque noise. Keeps the same assumed tool mass as the controller. Evaluation only.
fields.feedback_contact_rms_error_n: RMS difference between feedback and contact force over collected sample timestamps after start of trajectory (t>0.550 s).
fields.shadow_contact_rms_error_n: RMS difference between exact-acceleration shadow and contact force over the same timestamps.

samples.sample_selection: final delivered sample of completed trajectory
